_comment: Maps current PHMSA operator key (OPERATOR_ID_STOP) to predecessor keys that covered the same territory in earlier years. The build script backfills missing years from predecessor data. Edit this file to add/remove mappings, then re-run build_phmsa_timeseries_json.py.
